hub.title: Services: Web Design, Stores, Brands and Apps | The Brandle
hub.description: All 20 services from The Brandle, a Dubai design and development studio: websites, online stores, brand identity, apps, SEO and video. Fixed quote first.
hub.joke: One studio, twenty ways to give us work. Pick the one that sounds like your problem.
hub.intro: The Brandle is a Dubai studio that designs and builds websites, online stores, brand identities and apps, then looks after them. Every service below is done in-house, starts with a fixed quote and ends with you owning the files.
hub.price: Website and store plans run from $1,299 to $6,499, about AED 4,800 to 23,900. Apps, software and monthly work are quoted once we've seen the job. Either way the number is fixed before anything starts.

cta.p: Tell us the problem in plain words. We'll tell you which of the twenty fixes it, or that none of them do.
